messages:
Maria Chen: Quick thread — finalizing the go-live checklist for Wed's live demo. Focus: registration page, Zoom settings, who records, and how the recording + leads get routed. Need sign-off by 5pm PT.
Ajay Patel: Thanks — can you drop the registration URL and the HubSpot form IDs? I'll wire the Zap.
Maria Chen: Registration page: https://redwood.example.com/events/ldemo-mar31 (public). HubSpot form id: 5f8a2b. GA UTM: utm_campaign=ldemo_mar31&utm_source=web.
Olivia Rivera: Zoom conf: meeting scheduled as webinar (license in marketing account). Zoom link in calendar invite. Key settings I want confirmed: cloud recording enabled, auto-transcript on, alternative host = Ben, panelists set to "panelist", waiting room OFF, registration required via our page.
Ben Holt: Confirmed — I'm alt host. I'll enable "record to cloud" and set recording to start automatically. Also will enable "record active speaker and gallery".
Samir Kapoor: Add note — require consent to record on the registration page copy. Need checkbox: "I consent to be recorded and contacted" (HubSpot property -> legal_consent = true).
Maria Chen: Good catch. Also: post-event flows: 1) raw cloud recording -> Ops picks clips 2) transcript autogenerated -> send to content for highlight quotes 3) HubSpot workflow: create contact or attach to existing lead, set lifecycle_stage=lead, owner assignment rule = round-robin sales queue.
Ajay Patel: Zap mapping I plan: Registration webhook -> HubSpot contact create/update -> Add deal/contact property: webinar_name = "Live Demo Mar 31" -> Trigger automation to set lifecycle stage. Quick mapping snippet:
```
email -> contact.email
first_name -> contact.firstname
last_name -> contact.lastname
legal_consent -> contact.legal_consent
utm_campaign -> contact.hs_utm_campaign
```
Olivia Rivera: Note on recording retention: we should keep cloud recording for 90 days, then archive raw to S3:/marketing/webinars/2026-03-31-ldemo. OpsBot, can you confirm archive automation?
OpsBot: archive job scheduled. After 90 days, move Zoom cloud recording to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-03-31-ldemo and notify #marketing with link.
ZoomBot: Recording started by Ben Holt (cloud recording). Meeting ID: 987-654-321.
Ben Holt: Tech run checklist for speaker crew:
- 09:00 PT speaker mic + camera check
- 09:15 PT slides in presenter view + screen-share pass
- 09:25 PT full dress rehearsal 15m (simulate Q&A)
- I will keep local backup recording as fallback (local path on my laptop).
Maria Chen: Post-event deliverables timeline:
- 0-24h: thank-you email + replay link to registrants (unlisted replay)
- 24-72h: edited highlights (2x 2–3 min clips) posted -> social + blog
- 72-120h: full edited video + transcript + CTA to trial (tracked link)
Olivia Rivera: For the 0-24h email, please use template: subject: "Thanks for joining — replay + key takeaways" CTA should use tracking param ?utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ldemo_followup. Also include link to short feedback survey (Google Form).
Ajay Patel: Routing rule for HubSpot: if registrant is from enterprise domain (company size > 500) set owner = "AE-inbox", priority = high. Otherwise go into SDR queue. I'll add that filter in the Zap.
Samir Kapoor: Captioning: Zoom transcript ok for raw, but content will need full caption QC. Assign to Content Ops (Olivia) for QC and corrections.
Maria Chen: Who's owning clip selection? Ben? Olivia?
Ben Holt: I'll handle clip selection for the first pass. If Ops needs more, hand off to Content.
Olivia Rivera: I'll queue transcript QC and pull quotes for the blog. Will also coordinate with design for thumbnail.
Maria Chen: Final asks before EOD: Ajay confirm Zap + HubSpot mapping, OpsBot confirm archive automation email, Ben confirm auto-record settings, Olivia confirm transcript QC assigned.
Ajay Patel: Zap is ready, mapping + enterprise routing tested in staging. Will deploy to prod after sign-off.
OpsBot: Archive automation confirmed and test job completed successfully. Notification webhook to #marketing set.
Ben Holt: Auto-record settings are in Zoom and alt host set. Doing a quick test at 4pm PT.
Olivia Rivera: Transcript QC assigned to "Content Ops" and I'll add it to the task board.
Maria Chen: Perfect — thanks all. I'll post the final checklist to /shared/marketing/webinars and push calendar invite with speaker notes. :thumbsup:
Ben Holt: :rocket:
ZoomBot: Recording ended by Ben Holt. Duration: 01:02:45. Cloud recording available: https://zoom.us/recording/abc123
Maria Chen: After recording available, Ajay — please trigger HubSpot sequence for registrants + non-attendees: 1) attendees: send short survey + clip 2) non-attendees: send full replay + lead nurture flow.
Ajay Patel: On it — I'll include different email templates for attendees vs no-shows and tag contacts with "attended" property.
Maria Chen: Closing thread — if anything changes ping me. We'll review metrics next week (registrations, attendance %, clip CTR, MQL rate).
